items.answer: The OAuth 2.0 spec requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI, and the use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported. You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.
Xero supports the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension to the authorization code flow, allowing native apps to securely connect without needing to store a client secret.
Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 will use the new granular scopes. You can find a full list of scopes and their associated endpoints on the Scopes page.

checklist.answer: A new Partner Login URL field is now live in the Xero Developer Portal app configuration screen.
The OAuth 2.0 spec requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI, and the use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported. You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.
Xero supports the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension to the authorization code flow, allowing native apps to securely connect without needing to store a client secret.
Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 will use the new granular scopes. You can find a full list of scopes and their associated endpoints on the Scopes page.
All app partners will need to undertake a security assessment which will be reviewed by Xero's security team.
“Typically the assessment takes around 5 working days to complete, followed by 5-10 working days for us to assess your answers.”

Where a consumer of Xero's APIs does not adequately comply with these specifications Xero will issue them written notice giving them 30 days to advise the treatment plan and up to a further 60 days to complete the required work.
